branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A sour, cultured milk drink from the Faroe Islands, made by MBM, which is also used in cooking and baking. Lactic acid bacteria are stirred into skimmed milk, which sours over some hours.

sources.text: The drink, its method and its nutrition, from this page.
